com.addr.hunterj.jdbc
Interface JdbcQueryManager

All Known Implementing Classes:
QueryManager
public interface JdbcQueryManager

QueryManager is the central driver for a given set of queries. Each query is encapsulated within a JdbcQueryHandler. There is a many-to-one relationship between JdbcQueryHandler and QueryManager. There is a one-to-one relationship between QueryManager and the database connection. QueryManager is responsible for opening and closing the JDBC resources, Connection, Statement, and ResultSet, after execution of each JdbcQueryHandler.doQueryAndProcessResults().
